art_direction: 下缘较圆的中短眼共同向右上，上线简省，留白如缺边小叶，短眉轻抬。
composition: centered hand-drawn eye pair; auxiliary marks only when specified; large blank paper margins

color_randomization.method: golden-angle hue spacing with seeded single-hue saturation and lightness variation

color_treatment: one opaque flat color beside each pupil; no gradient or shaded rendering
creative_direction: Give each eye a full rounded lower bow beneath a shorter shallow upper contour. Keep the pen lines sparse and do not close every corner. Large black pupils look toward the upper right together. Leave broad leaf-shaped paper gaps within them, each with one missing edge. Use compact flat iris accents in the lower side spaces. Two short brow strokes sit a little higher than usual, still restrained. Maintain comparable eye sizes and clear central spacing. No mouth or extra expression lines.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
